Commentary: West Indies Squad: Brandon King, Tagenarine Chanderpaul, Kavem Hodge, Shai Hope, Amir Jangoo, Joshua Da Silva(w), Roston Chase(c), Jomel Warrican, Shamar Joseph, Kemar Roach, Jayden Seales, Kirk McKenzie, Joshua Bishop, Keemo Paul, Justin Greaves

Pakistan Squad: Azan Awais, Imam-ul-Haq, Shan Masood, Babar Azam(c), Abdullah Fazal, Awais Zafar, Mohammad Rizwan(w), Salman Agha, Aamer Jamal, Sajid Khan, Mohammad Ali, Mohammad Abbas, Khurram Shahzad, Ghazi Ghori, Ubaid Shah, Ali Usman, Saud Shakeel

West Indies head into the series on the back of a convincing Test series win over Sri Lanka just a month ago and will look to build on that momentum in familiar conditions. Pakistan, meanwhile, begin another phase with Babar Azam back at the helm, hoping the leadership change can bring better results after a difficult period in red-ball cricket. With valuable World Test Championship points up for grabs, neither side can afford a slow start.
